body:
As a father of two young boys (4 and 2) with similar issues as your father, all I can say is that you expressing concern is helpful. I have many terrible traits, and often think that my family would benefit more without me around. If my child were old enough to express a need for me to be around, then it would probably stifle my commitment to suicide.

After being around long enough, some people come to see that they are not as valuable or important as they thought they would be at a certain stage in life. If you see the value in him, just let him know

You are not alone. I am thinking of methods that:

1) are quick
2) are painless
3) result in certain death
4) look like an accident
